rationale.org-governance: Proposes cross-functional organizational framework for systematic AI risk assessment.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Prescribes static analysis, tests, threat modeling, and penetration testing.
rationale.quality-debt: Synthesizes inaccurate code, inefficiency, shallow content, and reduced design quality.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Requires GDPR, copyright, standards, and regulatory compliance checks.
rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Vendor assessment covers external AI services, data policies, storage, and access.
rationale.lit-review: Findings and framework derive from narrative synthesis of cited literature.
rationale.intro-framing: Names broad oversight gap but provides no operational workflow or thresholds.
rationale.assistive: Studies AI tools assisting developers with components, functions, and modules.
rationale.risk-security: Focally analyzes vulnerable or malicious generated code and security testing.
rationale.risk-quality: Focally analyzes nonfunctional code and degraded content and design quality.
rationale.risk-ip: Copyright, licensing, and dataset auditing receive dedicated assessment methods.
rationale.risk-bias: Bias risks and bias-detection methods are explicit framework components.
